description: Create a new virtual Generic repository in JFrog Artifactory that aggregates existing repositories. Settings: Repository Key: 'generic-virtual', Package Type: Generic, Description: 'Virtual repository aggregating generic repositories'. Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 using username 'admin' and password 'password'. Navigate to Administration > Repositories > Add Repositories > Virtual Repository, select Generic as the package type, enter the repository key 'generic-virtual', add the description 'Virtual repository aggregating generic repositories', add 'example-repo-local' as an included repository, and save.
